newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates up on fund shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates up on fund shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's inter-bank money market rates closed at higher levels on Wednesday amid a shortage of liquidity and are expected to remain firm when the market opens after the Friday weekend, dealers said.
Onvernight funds remained steady at the 20 percent level throughout the day, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
The borrowers who could not avail of the the State (central) Bank of Pakistan discounting facility covered their positions at higher levels.
The rates are likely to stay firm as no inflows are expected next week, the dealer said.
